description: A watercolor palette sits on the right side of the table, with a white paper cup of water and a fish painting on paper in the center. The left hand rests on the table near the paper while the right hand lifts the paintbrush away from the painting, reaches to the palette to pick up more paint, then moves left to dip and swish the brush inside the water cup before lifting it back out (right-hand object: paintbrush).
